creature.title: A Small White Creature Appears
creature.text: Would you like to be a magical girl?

marine.title: Marine Capture
marine.text: A group of Marines are holding someone in public, but you don’t know who. Will you save them?

keywords.SOUL GEM: Gain 15% Attack, Defense, and Speed. When this unit dies, it becomes a Witch that attacks everyone. Defeat the Witch to win.
keywords.WITCH: Attacks allies and enemies. Both teams can attack the Witch. It must be defeated before either team can win.
